description: Create a new private search job by changing the brief or criteria of a completed job. The original job stays unchanged.

brief.description: Replacement natural-language brief for the new job.

fields.description: Business fields to retain. Website and source evidence remain available for verification.

geography.description: Replacement city, region, country, or Worldwide.

id.description: Completed source job id returned by an earlier durable search call.

jobToken.description: Private token belonging to the source job.

limit.description: Maximum prospects retained by the new job.

target.description: Replacement business target for the new job.

name: refine_lead_search

cancelUrl.description: Authenticated REST URL for canceling queued or running work.

expiresInSeconds.description: Seconds until the private job and token expire.

exportUrl.description: Authenticated CSV export URL. Add format=json for JSON.

id.description: Stable job identifier. Use it with jobToken in every lifecycle call.

jobToken.description: Private bearer token required to read, refine, or export this job.

retryUrl.description: Authenticated REST URL for creating a replacement after retryable failure.

statusUrl.description: Authenticated REST URL for job status and result pages.

title: Refine a lead search
